summary: Possible typosquat of vue-demi with proof-of-concept content
details: Package name `vue-demi-fix` closely resembles the widely-used `vue-demi` Vue 2/3 compatibility shim. The published contents are a benign placeholder consisting of a single console.log identifying the package as a proof-of-concept claim. No exfiltration, install-time code execution, dropper, silent-relay, credential distribution, or backdoor mechanism is present in this version. The name similarity creates confusion risk for developers who mistype the legitimate package, but absent a payload the present harm to installers is limited.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
